title: eludite.browser.screenshot output
description: The screenshot. Over MCP, `image` is sent as image content and replaced by "(image content)" in the text and structured content (protocol/schemas/mcp-tool.json).

image.description: The encoded image, base64. Its media type is `image/png` or `image/jpeg` as `format` says.

scale.description: Image pixels per CSS pixel (below 1 when the capture was scaled down to `max_width`).

page_generation.description: The tab's page generation: it grows when the main frame navigates or the document is replaced (DOM.documentUpdated). Refs are valid only in the generation that issued them.

tab.description: The tab the command acted on.
